title: Medications through TSA screening
facts: Medication is allowed through TSA screening, and medically necessary liquids can exceed the ordinary 3.4-ounce liquid limit when screened under applicable procedures.
Travelers should tell the TSA officer about medically necessary liquids or related supplies at the start of screening when required.
TSA screening rules do not determine whether a medication is lawful to bring into another country; destination-country drug rules are separate.
Prescription labeling requirements can also depend on state law, airline procedures or international destination rules.
